title: Simple tomato pasta
description: Illustrative recipe for demonstrating the import format.

steps.title: Prepare sauce and pasta
steps.instruction: Open the sauce sub-session to start it cooking. While the sauce simmers, open the pasta sub-session. You can switch between both at any time; timers continue running.

steps.title: Bring water to a boil
steps.instruction: Bring a saucepan of water to a boil and salt to taste.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.instruction: Add the oil and tomatoes to a frying pan. Bring to a simmer, then cook gently for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Start the timer when the sauce is simmering. You can work in the pasta sub-session while it runs.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.instruction: Add the pasta to the boiling water and cook for the time stated on its packet. Start elapsed tracking when you add it, or set a manual countdown using the packet duration. Check before draining.
steps.completionCue: The pasta is cooked to your preference.

steps.title: Combine and serve
steps.instruction: Once both pasta and sauce are ready, drain the pasta and stir it into the sauce. Taste and serve.
